title: 第七章 计划执行
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

商场休息区。

中午刚吃完饭，休息区的沙发上零零星星坐着几对情侣休息着，腻在一块，最角落的那对情侣肩并肩，两颗脑袋碰在一起。

陈舟和张晚柠则是坐在休息区最边上的沙发上，张晚柠倚靠着椅背，横握着手机，小脸微微鼓起，露出一丝生气，嘴里念叨着。

“这个兰陵王好恶心啊！他一直抓我，你来玩！”

说完，她把黑着屏的手机塞到坐在旁边刷抖音的陈舟手里。

陈舟接过手机一看，好家伙，要吃5块钱低保了，但他还是认真的操作了起来。

换上陈舟操作后，一下子立竿见影，兰陵王针对了好几次都被反杀了，还在公屏打字。

“你给我等着。”

旁边的张晚柠挥舞着小粉拳，小嘴里振振有词，满脸报复成功后的喜悦。

“哈哈哈哈，你快打字嘲讽他！”

陈舟说：“你来吧。”

张晚柠接过手机，噼里啪啦的打了好几段。

“哟哟哟，等什么？等你来送？”

“别在峡谷刷微信步数了，你妈还等你回家吃饭呢！”

嘲讽完后，张晚柠心满意足地又把手机塞到了陈舟手里，她把手托在膝盖上，托着小脸，满眼都是小星星地看着陈舟。

“舟舟，你真厉害，嘿嘿。”

陈舟接着拿起手机打了起来，旁边的张晚柠则是拿起陈舟的手机，此时一个念头在心里形成。

知道他手机解锁密码，然后拿着他的手机给自己和姐姐共用的那个微信号发分手消息，那这样就相当于跟姐姐分手了，这样自己不就可以独占舟舟了。

不过自己怎么让他加上自己的现在的号呢？

此时一个大胆的想法在张晚柠脑海里升起，说干就干。

张晚柠拿着手机，好看的小脸上一改刚刚那副活泼的模样，化身成了一个赛博考官，讪讪地说。

“舟舟，我考考你，你的锁屏密码是不是我的生日？”

陈舟正操作着小乔跟兰陵王激战呢，也没想太多，下意识地说。

“不是。”

张晚柠接着引导道。

Page (1/3)

Shopping mall rest area.

We had just finished eating at noon, and there were several couples sitting on the sofa in the rest area, resting together. The couple in the corner were side by side, their heads touching.

Chen Zhou and Zhang Wan Ning were sitting on the sofa at the end of the rest area. Zhang Wan Ning was leaning on the back of the chair, holding his mobile phone horizontally, his face slightly bulging, showing a trace of anger, and he was mumbling.

"This Prince Lanling is so disgusting! He keeps catching me, and you come to play with me!"

After saying that, she put the phone with a black screen into the hand of Chen Zhou, who was sitting next to him and was scrolling through Douyin.

Chen Zhou took the phone and looked at it. Good guy, he was going to have to pay 5 yuan of subsistence allowance, but he still started to operate it seriously.

After being replaced by Chen Zhou, the effect was immediate. King Lanling targeted him several times but was counter-killed, and he was still typing on the public screen.

"Just wait for me."

Zhang Wanning next to her was waving her little pink fist, speaking plausibly, and her face was full of joy after her revenge was successful.

"Hahahaha, hurry up and type to mock him!"

Chen Zhou said, "Come on."

Zhang Wanning took the phone and typed several words.

"Yo yo yo, what are you waiting for? Waiting for you to deliver?"

"Stop checking your steps on WeChat in the canyon, your mother is still waiting for you to come home for dinner!"

After finishing the taunt, Zhang Wanning stuffed the phone into Chen Zhou's hand with satisfaction. She put her hands on her knees, her little face, and looked at Chen Zhou with stars in her eyes.

"Zhouzhou, you are so awesome, hehe."

Chen Zhou then picked up his cell phone and started calling. Zhang Wanning next to him picked up Chen Zhou's cell phone. At this time, an idea formed in his mind.

If you know the password to unlock his mobile phone, and then use his mobile phone to send a breakup message to the WeChat ID you share with your sister, then it is equivalent to breaking up with your sister, so that you can have the whole thing to yourself.

But how do I get him to add my current number?

At this time, a bold idea came to Zhang Wanning's mind, and he just went ahead with it.

Zhang Wanning held her mobile phone, her pretty little face changed from the lively look just now, and transformed into a cyber examiner, and said coquettishly.

"Zhouzhou, let me test you. Is your lock screen password my birthday?"

Chen Zhou was controlling Xiao Qiao in a fierce battle with King Lanling. He didn't think too much and said subconsciously.

"No."

Zhang Wanning then guided.
